settings.title: How much is delivery?
settings.text: England £10. Scotland and Wales £15. The Isle of Man, the Channel Islands, the Scottish Highlands and Islands and the Isles of Scilly £30. Delivery is free on orders of £100 or more to England, Scotland and Wales.

settings.title: Where do you deliver?
settings.text: England, Scotland and Wales, and the Scottish Highlands and Islands, the Isle of Man, the Channel Islands and the Isles of Scilly. We do not deliver to Northern Ireland, to BFPO addresses, to PO boxes, or outside the United Kingdom.

settings.title: When will my order arrive?
settings.text: Orders placed before noon on a working day are despatched the same working day. Then two to five working days to England, Scotland and Wales, longer to the islands.

settings.title: Does someone need to be in?
settings.text: Yes. Every order is signed for. We do not leave wine in a safe place, with a neighbour, or at a locker or parcel shop. Anyone aged 18 or over at the delivery address can sign for it if you have told us their name.

settings.title: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.text: Yes. You can cancel at any time from placing the order until 14 days after it is delivered.

settings.title: Who pays to send something back?
settings.text: On a change of mind you arrange the return and you pay for it. If a bottle arrived damaged, is faulty or corked, or we sent the wrong thing, you send nothing back and you pay nothing.

settings.title: A bottle arrived damaged.
settings.text: Email info@tikveslondon.uk within 48 hours with your order number and photographs of the bottle and the outer box. Nothing comes back. We replace or refund it, whichever you prefer.

settings.title: How do I get hold of you?
settings.text: Email info@tikveslondon.uk. We answer within two working days.
